mind_map.root_node: Symmetrical Designs (Reflection Lines, Rotational Turns & Block Crafts)

key_nodes: Line of Symmetry Definition: Imaginary axis dividing shape into two identical mirror halves that overlap perfectly when folded
Mirror Halves Property: Points on left side reflect to congruent equidistant points on right side
Vertical vs Horizontal Axes: Testing symmetry along vertical, horizontal, and diagonal fold lines
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming any line dividing a shape into two equal-area pieces is a line of symmetry.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Reflection Rule: A shape has line symmetry if folding along axis produces congruent matching halves.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Analyzing symmetry in butterfly wings, human faces, and architectural facades.

key_nodes: Square: 4 lines of symmetry (2 mid-sides, 2 diagonals)
Rectangle (non-square): 2 lines of symmetry (2 mid-sides only; diagonals are NOT symmetry lines)
Equilateral Triangle: 3 lines; Isosceles Triangle: 1 line; Scalene Triangle: 0 lines
Regular Hexagon: 6 lines; Circle: Infinite symmetry lines through center
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming the diagonal of a non-square rectangle is a line of symmetry (folding along diagonal does not overlap halves).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Regular Polygon Symmetry: A regular N-gon has exactly N lines of symmetry.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Architectural tile manufacturing and heraldic shield design.

key_nodes: Rotational Symmetry Definition: Figure looks identical to original position after rotation less than 360°
1/4 Turn (90°) Rotational Symmetry: Square, 4-blade firki pinwheel
1/2 Turn (180°) Rotational Symmetry: Rectangle, letters H, I, N, O, S, X, Z
Minimum Rotation Angle: Smallest degree turn that matches original appearance
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Believing letter N has reflection line symmetry (letter N has 180° rotational symmetry but zero reflection lines).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Rotational Appearance Rule: Shape matches original appearance at multiples of minimum rotation angle.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Designing ceiling fans, vehicle wheel rims, and company logos.

key_nodes: Order Definition: Number of times shape matches original appearance during a 360° full turn
Order Examples: Square = Order 4 (90°); Equilateral Triangle = Order 3 (120°); Rectangle = Order 2 (180°)
Alphabet Classification: Classifying English capital letters by reflection lines vs rotational order
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Stating Order = 0 for shapes without rotational symmetry (minimum order is 1 for 360° full turn).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Order of Rotation = 360° / Minimum Rotation Angle.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Analyzing hubcap designs and windmill blade efficiency.

key_nodes: Rajasthani Block Printing: Carved wooden blocks dipped in dye and stamped in repeating grid patterns
Translational & Rotational Motifs: Repeating design by sliding (translation) or turning block by 90°/180°
Grid Grid Layouts: Stamping blocks in alternating symmetrical orientations
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Disrupting repeating pattern spacing when stamping hand block prints.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Pattern Translation: Repeating motif at constant spatial intervals preserves overall visual symmetry.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Textile fabric design, saree borders, and carpet weaving.

key_nodes: Paper Firki (Pinwheel): Folding square paper diagonally and cutting alternate corners to build 4-blade rotational firki
Paper Snowflake Cut-Outs: Folding paper 3 or 4 times along symmetry lines and cutting shapes out of edges
Rangoli Symmetry: Creating radial symmetrical patterns using dots and lines
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Cutting through closed folded center spine of paper cut-outs (destroys unified snowflake structure).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Folded Symmetry: N folds produce 2^N or 2N symmetrical mirrored segments upon unfolding.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Festive decorations, paper craft design, and traditional floor Rangoli art.
